'''Sammel Yane''' was the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] ambassador to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and attache on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Attack on the Fortitude|attack]] on the [[Fortitude (Valor-class)|''Fortitude'']], Yane was asked to comment on the Empire's involvement, and released a short statement saying that the Empire had no operations in the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]] and could not be held responsible for the actions of "rogue elements".<ref name="TOR GNN">{{TORcite|type=message|SITH ATTACK AT DERALIA, REPUBLIC IN...|Galactic News Network: News Flash}}</ref>
